title: Battle of Montes Claros
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Montes Claros", at revision 1370450395, opens: "The Battle of Montes Claros was fought on 17 June 1665, near Borba, between Spanish and a combined Anglo-Portuguese force as the last major battle in the Portuguese Restoration War. The battle resulted in a decisive Portuguese victory and is considered one of the most important battles in the country's history." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2889383, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1665 decisive battle of the Portuguese Restoration War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
